notes: Printing: copies now fill the sheet -- three across and three down on letter or A4, 2.5 mm apart for cutting -- and spill on to more sheets past nine.
Printing: lighter and smoother on an inkjet. The card's dither is turned back into grey and the printer lays it down with its own fine halftone, so it matches the preview on the screen.

Printing: a job that broke off half way (a printer waking up, a WiFi hiccup) is sent again from the top; the Pro waits up to a minute for a sleepy printer and keeps its radio fully awake while the job moves.
Printing: big jobs stream to the printer a sheet at a time instead of being built in memory first.
